note: Every file allowed to name a model provider's host, and why. A new file is a new model sink: add it here (reviewer-2 signs off), and it must call kernel/door. Files under retrofit_pending still reach providers directly today and move behind the door in the retrofit.
control: The control is the egress firewall (K6 and the host): the box lets only the gateway reach provider hosts. This list is a smoke test that catches the honest mistake in review.

not_inference.core/models/index.js: reads openrouter.ai's public model list (price, context, capabilities) with a plain keyless GET through lib/http.js; it sends no prompt, no key and no person's data, so it is not a model call and has no use for the door
not_inference.core/vault/rotate.js: rotates a provider API key; sends no prompt
not_inference.lib/agent-sandbox.js: names each provider's sign-in and API hosts for the sandbox's egress allow-list and the self-test; it sends nothing itself
not_inference.core/sessions/member-endpoints.js: the allow-list of addresses a MEMBER's API key may be sent to (the provider's own, and api.x.ai for an OpenAI-style key); pure functions that compare an address, they make no request and carry no prompt or key; the check narrows what a member may do and the server applies it before any call goes through the door
not_inference.apps/app/src/host/host-core.js: the page host for a browser with no daemon: it compares a typed key's base_url with the one allowed xAI address (api.x.ai/v1) to refuse any other, and passes the key on to the server's sessions.accounts.key over the paired connection; it opens no connection to a provider, sends no prompt, and the server (not this file) checks the key with the provider
